direction: Make a cluster-aware depot start evaluable with one row at a time.
hypothesis: A feasible two-signal anchor can test the start mechanism while retaining adaptive angular savings.

operations.mechanism: Only at the depot compare a radial anchor with the nearest other feasible customer distance. Compute each peer minimum by direct row indexing and a boolean mask, using ordinary loops and np.min. Avoid np.ix_, np.fill_diagonal and np.partition. Copy the incumbent scoring away from the depot.

preserve: Keep the existing CVRP interface, read-only inputs, feasibility and deterministic evaluation. Preserve useful incumbent structure unless the mechanism calls for a deliberate pivot.
reasoning_summary: The two cluster-aware start proposals were rejected before route scoring. The reported disallowed attributes were ix_ and fill_diagonal, so the outcome cannot assess the start heuristic. Use the selected complete in-run Memory record as advisory context.
